messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is prescribed to manage polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
It is prescribed because it improves how the body responds to insulin.
PCOS affects about 1 in 10 women of reproductive age.
PCOS is often marked by insulin resistance.
Insulin resistance is a condition in which the body doesn't respond well to insulin.
Poor response to insulin prompts the pancreas to produce more.
This excess insulin drives up androgen production.
Androgen is a male hormone.
This process worsens symptoms like irregular periods, infertility, acne, and excess hair growth.
Metformin helps by lowering insulin levels.
Metformin helps by decreasing the liver's glucose production.
Metformin helps by improving glucose uptake by muscles.
Metformin helps by reducing circulating androgen levels.
Reducing circulating androgen levels can support more regular ovulation.
Reducing circulating androgen levels can support more regular menstrual cycles.
Metformin is not FDA-approved to treat PCOS.
Metformin is widely prescribed as an off-label treatment.
Triplet: ["this process", "worsens", "acne"]

The relation 'worsens' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject process or condition exacerbates or aggravates the object condition or symptom.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'caused by': The subject condition or event is caused by the entity specified by the object.
B. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has symptom': The medical condition specified by the subject may present with the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'resolves with': The effect or symptom specified by the subject entity typically subsides or stops when the condition specified by the object entity occurs.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
